title: Clear the bare-form-control lint debt — 29 warnings across 13 files
description: MPI-582 added the `mpi/no-bare-form-control` ESLint rule but cleared only the files it touched. 29 warnings remain across 13 files. Because the pre-commit hook runs `eslint --max-warnings=0` over staged `js/**/*.js`, EVERY ONE of these files is a commit landmine: any change to it is rejected on warnings the author did not write. MPI-504 hit this on MpiBaseFlow.js and lost a session to it.
